user.title: DSBmobile account
user.description: Credentials as used in the DSBmobile app. The plan is loaded once per account; filter by class on the dashboard or with the `get_entries` action.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for {username} are no longer accepted. Please enter the password again.

error.invalid_auth: User ID or password is wrong.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The user ID of an existing account cannot be changed. Please add a new account instead.

init.title: DSB substitution plan
init.description: The sensor "Substitution plan" holds the entries from today up to N days ahead.

get_entries.name: Get entries
get_entries.description: Returns the substitution entries of the coming days, optionally for one class.

class_name.name: Class
class_name.description: e.g. 08b. Empty = all classes. Merged classes such as 08abc are matched.

days_ahead.name: Days
days_ahead.description: Number of days from today. Default: the integration option.

config_entry.name: Account
config_entry.description: Only needed with several DSB accounts.
